judge_notes: Code run on Ray 2.60.0 (= docs 'latest') in a scratch uv venv under /tmp, AWS creds removed, transformers replaced by a scripted fake (no torch). preference.reason: Very close (sums 71 vs 70). X covers production better: RayService update paths, upgrade strategies, deploy logs, autoscaling gauges. All of its runnable code works. Y explains design better (RFC rationale, prefix-tree trade-off, consistency patterns) and has the non-official sources X lacks, but its custom-router decorator is broken code a reader would copy, and it adds meta/entity-leak defects. Both have about 8% claim error rates; X's errors are prose (stale aggregation modes, one wrong worked example) rather than code.
